what_it_proves: for each address, the project's generated body and the ORIGINAL's machine code at that VA agree on the registers and the named memory, over the entry states driven
what_it_does_not_prove: anything about other entry states, other addresses, or the game as a whole; there is no aggregate verdict

addresses.compares: the eight general-purpose registers and the bytes of every absolute guest address the generated body names
addresses.does_not_compare: DF only: the body publishes g_flag_k/a/b/cf and recomp_eflags() derives CF/PF/AF/ZF/SF/OF from them, but the direction flag is not among the published words

input_set.seeded: each named address holds 0x9E3779B9*(case+1) on both sides; registers are per-case constants; esp is a stack page whose top word is the return sentinel
input_set.not_covered: any entry state other than these, any address the body does not name, and any input the game would supply
